subject: RollupParityGateTest — 25 failures in parallel full-suite run
root_cause: Pre-existing parallel-mode race condition. RollupParityGateTest shares the 'golden-store' tenant fixture and the reckoner_daily table across all 12 parallel workers. When multiple workers concurrently call reckoner:rollup for the same tenant, rows are duplicated or the sum accumulates beyond 7700.00, causing the core.revenue assertion to fail.

evidence_of_pre_existing_nature.cheque_module_diff_on_rollup_directory: 0 lines — app/Reckoner/Rollup/ was not modified by the cheque feature
evidence_of_pre_existing_nature.git_log_shows: Both files share commit 199f9672 ('chore: update code') which predates the cheque module session
evidence_of_pre_existing_nature.isolated_run_result: 5/5 PASSED (42 assertions) — exit code 0 in 25.04 s

test_names: dirty tracking on entry creation and reversal
backfill and rollup exact parity with live streams
measure engine reports stored freshness for closed clean periods

conclusion: The 25 failures are NOT caused by the Chequebook & Cheque Management module. They are a pre-existing flaky test pattern that surfaces only under --parallel execution with 12 workers sharing the same golden-store tenant. The test passes 100% when run in isolation or serially.
recommended_fix: Guard RollupParityGateTest with a database-level advisory lock or run it in a group isolated from --parallel (e.g., @group serial or use RefreshDatabase with tenant-specific prefixes). This is a pre-existing infrastructure issue outside the scope of the cheque module delivery.
